name: deepseek-v4-1-flash-h200-agentx-4node
objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs

recipe.label: AgentX run recipe: 300 s idle-gap cap, 10 warm-up requests per lane, trajectory start 0.25 to 0.75, 3600 s window, 30 s grace, corpus semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126

scope: cluster; worst instance for TTFT and end-to-end gates

sweeps.name: topology-ep
sweeps.narrative: Wide tp8 instances should win at the SLO, and EP should pay more as dp spreads 128 experts over more ranks.

sweeps.name: batch-caps
sweeps.narrative: max_num_seqs 16 should bind on 4 instances but not 8, while a larger token budget lifts both until ITL breaks.

sweeps.name: prefill-chunking
sweeps.narrative: Capping long prefills should cut ITL p99 enough to push the SLO knee past 96 lanes, at a small cost in raw throughput.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: DeepEP low-latency should win at EP width 4-8 and lose to high-throughput at width 32, where dispatch volume dominates.

sweeps.name: drafting
sweeps.narrative: dspark should raise tok/s/GPU at K 3-5 but lift ITL p99 toward the 20ms SLO, so the best K may differ between shapes.

sweeps.name: routing-prefix-cache
sweeps.narrative: prefix-affinity with caching on should win, and the routing spread should widen from 4 to 8 instances.

sweeps.name: kv-headroom
sweeps.narrative: gmu 0.95 should lift the KV-starved tp4 shapes noticeably and leave tp8 flat.

sweeps.name: cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: FULL and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE should edge out the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
